chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from some of our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the turban for the deceased, he said: "Pass it beneath his chin."

key_terms.الْإِسْنَادِ: the chain of narrators transmitting the hadith
key_terms.الْعِمَامَةِ: the turban used for the deceased
key_terms.حَنِّكْهُ: pass it beneath his chin; apply tahnīk to him

ai.seo_question: How should the turban be placed on a deceased person according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a funerary ruling concerning how the turban is to be arranged for the deceased. It indicates that the turban should be placed with tahnīk, meaning it is passed beneath the chin as part of the burial preparation.
